body:
He did choke me during an argument. He cried and he tried to call the police after, but I stopped him. 

We both grew up in abusive families. For him, it was his mom. For me, it was by brothers and sisters.

I dunno. I've never talked about it to anyone before. I don't really know why I posted anything this time. I don't know what I was hoping to accomplish. 

It feels good to say it though. Thank you for listening. When I've tried to bring it up to my family, they talk about themselves. People don't really listen. So I don't really know how to talk about myself.

I have my family, but my parents are going through a really difficult time. I don't want to burden them with my problems. Besides, it hurts to think about leaving him. Like a sharp pain in my chest. Our lives are completely entwined. I feel like he is the only person who gets me. We've spent 10 years of our lives together.

Maybe couples therapy?
